content.text: I'm fighting the first wave in box 1. I've taken a couple of hits, so I'm switching to kicks and throws.
Three enemies are each down to 4 HP. I'm finishing them off with punches.
3 kills so far. I'm still fighting the incoming fodder and watching where the debris settles so I can start stacking it.
HP is 76 and four enemies are left at 16 HP each. I'm letting them bunch up so one drop-kick hits several.

content.text: HP has dropped to 44, so I'm fighting more carefully. Next I'll kick the enemy right below me.
I have 7 kills, but HP is down to 28 and I haven't escaped box 1 yet. I'll keep using drop-kicks, which have worked best.
HP is down to 20 and a 60-HP thug is approaching from the east. I'll drop-kick it to stagger it.
Few calls left; I'm cleaning up the two weakened fodder before the thugs arrive.
I'm almost out of calls and down to 12 HP, so I'm backing away from the thugs to stay alive.
